subtasks.title: Gate the 'No Kits Reporting GPS' notice behind a positionsLoaded flag + show a bare centered spinner during initial load
subtasks.approach: In stores/map.js add `const positionsLoaded = ref(false)`; set it true inside fetchDriverPositions() after the try/catch (before the return) so it flips on the first attempt whether the fetch succeeds or its error is caught; export it in the store return object. In App.vue add `&& mapStore.positionsLoaded` to the noKitsReporting computed so neither the centered card nor the bottom pill can render before the first positions fetch resolves; add a v-if spinner block gated on `mapStore.adminMode && mapStore.liveMode && !mapStore.positionsLoaded`, rendered as a bare centered animate-spin inline-SVG (no card, no text) in the same fixed centered overlay position as the notice card. No timeout.
subtasks.intended_diffs: map.js: +positionsLoaded ref (~160); +positionsLoaded.value=true in fetchDriverPositions before return (~959); +positionsLoaded in return object (~1072). App.vue: noKitsReporting computed gains `&& mapStore.positionsLoaded` (~351-357); +spinner overlay block (bare centered animate-spin SVG) gated on adminMode && liveMode && !positionsLoaded.
